description: Flange on high pressure hydrocarbon line operating at 400 psi began spraying aerosol mist. Isolation valve was seized and secondary block valve was bypassed with temporary jumper.
Hydraulic press mechanical interlock guard fell off mounting bracket. Operator reached hand inside die to clear metal shaving before tripping e-stop.
Crane hoist cable frayed with multiple broken strands while moving 8-ton chemical ISO container over operator walkway. Exclusion zone tape was torn.
Technician opened 480V motor control center switchgear without wearing arc-rated face shield or performing zero voltage verification test.
Small plastic coffee cup lid on floor in administration lobby near water cooler.
Flickering overhead lightbulb in tool calibration office. Work order requested.
Confined space vessel entry permit expired while contractors were still inside inspecting sludge. Sniffer gas alarm sounded indicating low oxygen at 18.5%.
Contractor working on pipe rack at 28ft height slipped on wet metal grating. Safety harness lanyard was hooked to unrated electrical conduit instead of certified static line anchor.
